title: What is in a Lucene index? Adrien Grand, Software Engineer, Elasticsearch
summary: Elasticsearch engineer and Lucene committer Adrien Grand explains the design decisions inside a Lucene index and what problems it can and cannot solve. The talk goes into how Lucene stores data for fast search and analytics.
why: HN recommends it as an instructive, easy-to-follow look at Lucene internals from a core committer.

quote.text: I can super highly recommend talks by Adrien Grand on Lucene and Elasticsearch.
